title: Settings
subtitle: Relance engine parameters and shared referentials of the manager space: business lines, session tags, sites and rooms.

relance.title: Mail relances
relance.description: Parameters of the engine picking the users to remind and the sessions proposed to them.
relance.seatMarginHint: Invitations sent per free seat, to offset users who never answer.
relance.daysBetweenHint: A user reminded recently is dropped from the next run.
relance.expiringSoonHint: A valid training joins the relance queue within this window before expiry.
relance.sessionsPerMailHint: Maximum number of slots listed inside one invitation.
relance.autoRunTimeHint: Time of the daily automatic run.
relance.senderHint: Address shown as the sender of the invitations.
relance.autoRunHint: Runs the engine every day without any action.
relance.onCancelHint: Immediately reminds a user whose validation has been cancelled.
relance.estimate: About {invitations} invitations for {seats} free seats across the upcoming sessions.

categories.title: Business lines
categories.description: The business line is the category carried by the training. It is used as a filter across the manager space.
categories.drawerSubtitle: A business line groups several trainings.
categories.nameHint: Two characters minimum, visible in every filter.
categories.renameWarning: {count, plural, one {# training carries this business line and will be updated.} other {# trainings carry this business line and will be updated.}}

tags.title: Session tags
tags.description: Common referential of the free tags proposed when creating a session.
tags.usage: {count, plural, =0 {No session} one {# session} other {# sessions}}
tags.addHint: The figure shows how many sessions already carry the tag.
tags.duplicate: This tag is already in the referential.
tags.removeUsed: The tag "{name}" is set on {count, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}. It leaves the suggestions but stays visible there.
tags.removeUnused: The tag "{name}" is set on no session. It will be removed from the suggestions.
tags.emptyHint: Add a first tag to propose it when creating a session.

rooms.title: Sites and rooms
rooms.description: Rooms available per site. The room is picked session by session, never frozen at series level.
rooms.siteSummary: {rooms, plural, one {# room} other {# rooms}} · {capacity} seats in total
rooms.booked: {count, plural, =0 {No upcoming session} one {# upcoming session} other {# upcoming sessions}}
rooms.emptyHint: Add a room to be able to pick it when planning a session.
rooms.buildingHint: Pick an existing building or type a new one.
rooms.capacityHint: Number of seats, cap of the registrations to a session.
